我开心的一天(My Happy Day): 说话者用简单英语介绍自己的一天与喜好。
I like my life very much.
I go to the supermarket every Friday.
The train station is not far from my home.
The hotel is big and clean.
Best of all, they cancelled the picnic because of the storm.
column3: 因为暴风雨他们取消了野餐。
